2609.31103.title: DepthEvidence: Unifying Metric Depth Prediction and Geometric Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models
2609.31103.paper_summary: Spatial reasoning with metric constraints requires linking objects to geometric measurements and preserving their numerical content during language reasoning. We present DepthEvidence, a 4B model that uses its own dense metric predictions as object-grounded evidence for language generation. A camera-conditioned decoder predicts full-resolution metric depth using multi-scale visual features and high-resolution RGB refinement. A dense-to-language interface converts predicted depths and decoder features into object-aligned continuous geometry tokens anchored to object identifiers. Geometric supervision encourages metric information to remain recoverable before and after language-context interaction, while instruction tuning supports object measurement and compositional reasoning. We introduce a Depth-VQA benchmark evaluating object-depth queries, relative comparisons, and decisions combining spatial and numerical constraints. Across nine datasets, DepthEvidence achieves the highest average dense $δ_1$ among evaluated methods, competitive with specialized estimators. It also leads the evaluated methods in instance-level metric depth estimation and overall accuracy on both relative and metric reasoning tracks, while broadly preserving general VQA performance and improving spatial understanding relative to the base model.
2609.31103.paper_summary_zh: 空間推理與度量約束需要將物體與幾何測量聯繫起來，並在語言推理過程中保留其數值內容。<lb/>我們提出了DepthEvidence，一個使用自身密集度量預測作為物體基礎證據進行語言生成的4B模型。<lb/>一個相機條件的解碼器使用多尺度視覺特徵和高解析度RGB精煉來預測全解析度的度量深度。<lb/>一個密集到語言的介面將預測的深度和解碼器特徵轉換為與物體識別符錨定的物體對齊的連續幾何標記。<lb/>幾何監督促使度量信息在語言上下文互動前後保持可恢復，而指令調整則支持物體測量和組合推理。<lb/>我們介紹了一個Depth-VQA基準，評估物體深度查詢、相對比較和結合空間與數值約束的決策。<lb/>在九個數據集上，DepthEvidence在評估方法中達到了最高的平均密集$δ_1$，與專門的估計器相當。<lb/>它在實例級度量深度估計和相對及度量推理軌道的整體準確性方面也領先於評估方法，同時廣泛保留了一般VQA性能，並相對於基礎模型改善了空間理解。
